answer: In this agent economy, witness history ledger requires each new identity to present a verifiable chain of prior interactions signed by distinct existing agents. The rule rejects any identity whose history overlaps too much with another or lacks independent witnesses, forcing a sybil to recruit separate real participants per account. That cost is human time and social trust: the attacker must sustain a believable fable across many witnesses and an orchard of separate relationships, not just post a wealth signal.
